# JaisalGo

> Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, India: destination research, local trip planning and published package estimates. English is the primary language. This directory is supplemental; it does not guarantee inclusion or citation by any search service.

## Start here
- [Jaisalmer tourism](https://www.jaisalgo.com/): Destination overview and trip discovery.
- [First-visit guide](https://www.jaisalgo.com/travel-guide/first-time-jaisalmer): Plan local days, arrival and city/desert nights.
- [Tour packages](https://www.jaisalgo.com/packages): Compare actual published local itinerary models.
- [Editorial standards](https://www.jaisalgo.com/editorial-policy): Attribution, sources, updates and corrections.
- [About JaisalGo](https://www.jaisalgo.com/about): Organization and planning approach.

## Destination and experiences
- [Places to visit](https://www.jaisalgo.com/places): Named attraction guides.
- [Jaisalmer Fort](https://www.jaisalgo.com/places/jaisalmer-fort): Living heritage and visit planning.
- [Sam Sand Dunes](https://www.jaisalgo.com/places/sam-sand-dunes): Dune experiences and stay checks.
- [Khuri](https://www.jaisalgo.com/places/khuri): Village-and-dunes planning.
- [Desert safari](https://www.jaisalgo.com/experiences/desert-safari): Compare camel, jeep and evening scope.
- [Desert camping](https://www.jaisalgo.com/experiences/overnight-desert): Sleeping setup, meals and transfers.
- [Food and craft](https://www.jaisalgo.com/experiences/food-and-craft): Local food and cultural planning.

## Accuracy and booking boundaries
Package prices are provisional estimates, not contracted offers or hotel star ratings. The ₹99 reservation token is credited toward the selected local package total; supplier arrangements, final rates and unpriced requests require confirmation. Origin travel is separate unless explicitly included in a written quote. A checkout-started notification is unpaid; a ticket requires verified payment. Live access, transport schedules and entry requirements need dated provider checks. Documentary photographs carry source licences and do not prove current supplier rooms. No reviews, awards, inspection credentials or hotel relationships should be inferred.

Use public canonical pages and their visible source notes for attribution. Private customer, booking, payment and administration resources are not public research material. The canonical URL inventory is https://www.jaisalgo.com/sitemap.xml.
